Package gui

Class BookingConfirmationController

java.lang.Object
gui.BookingConfirmationController
public class BookingConfirmationController extends Object
controller for the booking confirmation screen (BookingConfirmationFrame.fxml).

BookingController uses the FXMLLoader instance API to load this screen, then calls populate(BookingResult) directly on the controller so that all @FXML-injected fields are guaranteed to be set before any data-binding runs. for confirmed bookings the entry-pass card is shown immediately. the card is hidden for waiting-list entries.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      called by the FXMLLoader after all @FXML fields have been injected. nothing to do here; all data-binding is done in populate(BookingResult) which is called explicitly by BookingController after loading.

    • populate

      public void populate(logic.BookingResult r)
      binds the booking result to all detail labels and, for confirmed bookings, generates the QR entry pass. called by BookingController immediately after loader.load() so every @FXML field is already injected.
      Parameters:
      r - the confirmed booking or waiting-list result; must not be null

    • generateEntryPass

      private void generateEntryPass(logic.BookingResult r)
      builds the QR canvas for this booking and inserts it into the entry-pass card. the pass encodes GONATURE:ORDER=<id>:VISITOR=<visitorId> and also shows the entry number as plain text so the visitor can quote it verbally at the gate.
      Parameters:
      r - the confirmed booking result
